title: Banking customer and relationship data quality pilot
use_case: Customer data quality and relationship servicing
description: Profile a bounded sample of customer and relationship records, surface duplicate or incomplete fields for staff review, and establish data-quality measures before considering downstream servicing or reporting use.

title: UK retail KYC document intake and verification
description: Prototype document intake, extraction of agreed identity fields, and analyst verification for a narrow onboarding cohort. Keep exception handling and final identity decisions with authorized staff.
required_capabilities: Access controls, retention rules, and audit trail

title: India customer onboarding KYC assistance
description: Evaluate document extraction and completeness checks for an approved sample of onboarding cases. Confirm permitted document types, data handling, and institution-specific policy with the customer before configuration.
required_capabilities: Human review for mismatches and low-confidence results
Policy-specific controls confirmed by the customer

title: UK SME loan underwriting decision support
description: Assist underwriters by organizing approved application documents, extracting agreed evidence fields, and highlighting missing information. The prototype supports review and does not make lending decisions.
required_capabilities: Clear separation from automated credit decisions

title: India MSME loan application review
description: Prototype application triage and evidence organization for MSME lending cases using customer-approved data. Underwriters retain authority for eligibility assessment and credit decisions.
required_capabilities: Approved MSME application and transaction-summary samples
Human underwriting review and access logging

title: UK insurance claims intake and triage
description: Organize first-notice-of-loss submissions, classify attachments, summarize claim evidence, and identify missing information for handler review. Coverage and settlement decisions remain with claims staff.
required_capabilities: Approved historical or synthetic claim samples
Handler review with traceable source material

title: India motor insurance claims assistance
description: Test intake classification, document checklist completion, and human-reviewed claim routing for a bounded motor-claims sample. Validate local product and process rules with the insurer.
required_capabilities: Approved motor-claim sample and document types
Human review for routing and fraud indicators
Customer-approved data retention and access controls

title: UK regulatory reporting data reconciliation
description: Reconcile a limited set of approved source fields against a customer-provided reporting specification, flag discrepancies, and preserve reviewer sign-off. Reporting interpretation and submission remain customer-owned.
required_capabilities: Controlled sample from relevant source systems
Compliance reviewer sign-off and versioned evidence

title: India regulatory reporting preparation checks
description: Prototype completeness and consistency checks for a customer-selected reporting dataset and specification. The institution confirms applicable obligations and retains control of interpretation and submission.
required_capabilities: Authorized compliance review before any use

title: Financial crime alert investigation triage
description: Group related alerts and assemble investigator context for a human-led review pilot. Use approved test data, preserve evidence lineage, and do not automatically block transactions or determine customer outcomes.
required_capabilities: Investigator review, escalation, and disposition capture

title: Financial services customer-service copilot
description: Help service agents find approved knowledge and draft responses for review in a bounded set of service scenarios. Agents approve all customer-facing responses and escalate sensitive or uncertain cases.
reusable_components: Knowledge retrieval and answer citation pattern
